name: The Dawn
blurb: Bulletin boards, Usenet and forwarded email. Culture spread by text, one inbox at a time.

name: Flash & Forums
blurb: GeoCities pages, Newgrounds and Something Awful. Looping animations and in-jokes that took weeks to travel.

name: Broadcast Yourself
blurb: YouTube arrives, 4chan names the image macro, and a single link can fool millions.

name: The Social Boom
blurb: Facebook, Twitter, Reddit and Tumblr turn memes into a shared global language overnight.

name: Six Seconds & Up
blurb: Vine, Snapchat and early TikTok. Memes get shorter, faster and stranger.

name: The Algorithm Age
blurb: The feed decides. Lockdown humor, AI-generated absurdity and brainrot spread at algorithmic speed.
